create.description: Caller constructs Goal struct and calls GoalRegistry.Register

activate.description: Goal transitions from pending to active

satisfy.description: Goal achieved when Progress=1.0 or business logic determines completion

abandon.description: Goal explicitly abandoned by user or system

fail.description: Goal cannot be achieved (derived from repeated failures)
fail.note: No explicit FAILED status; abandoned or wish used instead

wish.description: Long-term aspiration that may never be fully achieved
